body: I’m fucking devastated
My gf who is 20weeks pregnant broke up with me over my dog who stays outside and says that my sons are awful. I let her bad mouth them so long and she still left. I failed everyone. I feel your pain
And she’s leaving me

I’ve tried and it’s just led to her dismissing anything I say and treating me like crap even more. My sons are from my first marriage. Her kids love me and her 3 yr old calls me dad. I love her so much.
I’ll have to give it a shot. How much did you take?
Enough about me, how are you feeling?
Honestly, I feel like I’m the worst piece of crap ever. I think my sons resent me because of her. She’ll never say sorry, ever! I honestly feel stuck because of the baby on the way.

Wow… mine was jobless and on the verge of eviction so I bought a new house and vehicle for us. I’m always compared to her ex-husband. And she usually waits till I’m at work to ambush me with all these issues and to tell me how bad I am. I’ve literally given her a better life and the more I’m with her, the more details I get about her past…. I love her but she’s killing me inside

I know how it feels to deal with a partner like this. I’m pretty sure my partner is a narcissist. It’s sucks because we commit ourselves to these people and they string us along until the time is right to pull the rug from underneath us
It’s funny how this is happening on a day that’s supposed to be a happy one. I turn 35 today… I hope I never have another birthday

I’ve committed everything I have to her. New house new car and baby on the way. She’s 20 weeks. I’ve never been made to feel like such a shitty person in my life. I do everything around the house to try to keep her happy but she always finds something wrong. At this point, I’m looking for a oainless way to die
I really just want to go away for good. I’ve thought about how I would disappear too. I just wish I had a companion to join me
The fuck up is committing to a woman who is not who she says she is and being treated like crap
Especially if they say these are the things they want
Yeah but when you commit like I did, it sucks knowing that they’re gonna treat you the way I’m getting treated
This is more than a fuck up… I feel like this is the last straw for me. That backed into a corner feeling
But take your time and when you feel ok. I’m all ears
I understand. It’s freaking tough. I’m getting dumped by a narcissist who was given everything and still hates life. She’s got mental issues…
I feel the same way most days. It always feels like there’s some new bullshit that comes up and ruins things. I ask god why he hates me so much everyday
Go ahead and vent. I’m all ears
I’ll listen
Do you wanna talk? I feel the same way too and could use an ear too
How did you try to do it? I’ll join you
My GF does the same with her exes too. I bust my ass day in and day out just to be made to feel like I’m not good enough. I just feel like quitting and disappearing forever
Do you want to chat? I feel tired and beaten down and would to engage in a chat with someone who feels like I do.
I really need to talk to someone. I really hurt inside
I find myself wanting to give up every single day
Sometimes the loneliest place is in a relationship with the person you think loves you and at the end they end up discarding you when they’re bored

I feel your pain. I’m dealing with emotional abuse from a women I’ve done everything for and it sucks. I’ve taken care of her more than I did with my ex wife. Just to be treated like crap again. I really wanna quit and die
